part.text:
Fixed. In both `tokio/src/net/unix/listener.rs:84` and `tokio/src/net/unix/stream.rs:80`, the leading `\0` is now stripped before calling `StdSocketAddr::from_abstract_name`, which expects the abstract name without the prefix (previously the extra `\0` became part of the socket name and shortened the `sockaddr_un` by one byte).

Verified with `cargo test -p tokio --test uds_stream --test uds_datagram --features full` — all 20 tests pass, including `abstract_socket_name`.
